findings.title: WAF / Anti-Bot Mitigation Dropping Automated Probes (www.goindigo.in)
findings.description:
The target host completed the TLS handshake (Subject: '*.goindigo.in', Issuer: 'DigiCert Inc'), but subsequent automated HTTP requests were dropped or timed out by an edge Web Application Firewall (WAF) or Bot Management system ().

Because the edge security layer blackholes/drops automated scanner traffic, dynamic scanners (ZAP, Nuclei, Wapiti, Nikto) were unable to receive HTTP response payloads from the web application.
